about_the_game:
America's Most Addictive Game - Remade!

You take control of a cursor in the center grid and must launch yourself towards the enemies that surround you. Match their color to destroy the enemies! But be careful, traps are everywhere and once the enemies reach the center it's game over. 

Game Features:

  • Unique Maps

  • Engaging and Detailed Map Design

  • Classic Mode (Based on the Original Game)

  • In-game Powerups

  • Achievements

  • Supports Keyboard and Gamepad

  • Steam Cloud Support

  • Optichallenge

What is an optichallenge?

The map surrounding the playfield will try to distract you with visuals you may not expect in an attempt to make you lose your attention and focus. Some maps might be easy while others are going to be far more challenging!

Do you have what it takes to beat all the levels and conquer ZOOP WORLD?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 with 1.0GHz (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: ZOOP WORLD is a fun and engaging spin on a classic retro title from 1995. Defend the center grid from a growing number of enemies closing in on you. Battle on multiple maps around the world of Planet Z and see if you have what it takes to become a ZOOP WORLD Master!
